notes: These candidate mappings use the exact IEEE 1516.1-2025 C++ RTIambassador and FederateAmbassador declarations and their canonical clause labels. The scenario queries one known owned attribute and checks its ordinary federate owner; it does not claim the complete ownership-query result space or conformance.

requirements.statement: A joined observer queries ownership of the adapter-supplied known object attribute; the test checks the resulting report without changing ownership.
The observer receives exactly one callback identifying the queried object, queried attribute set, and current owner's FederateHandle.
